occupations.title: Electricians
occupations.description: Install, maintain, and repair electrical wiring, equipment, and fixtures.

occupations.title: Heating, Air Conditioning, and Refrigeration Mechanics and Installers
occupations.description: Install or repair heating, central air conditioning, HVAC, or refrigeration systems.

occupations.title: Welders, Cutters, Solderers, and Brazers
occupations.description: Use hand-welding, flame-cutting, soldering, or brazing equipment to join or repair metal components.

occupations.title: Computer Numerically Controlled Tool Operators
occupations.description: Operate computer-controlled machines or robots to perform machining operations on metal or plastic work pieces.

occupations.title: Computer User Support Specialists
occupations.description: Provide technical assistance to computer users and help diagnose hardware, software, and user issues.

occupations.title: Computer Network Support Specialists
occupations.description: Analyze, test, troubleshoot, and evaluate existing network systems.

occupations.title: Medical Assistants
occupations.description: Perform administrative and certain clinical duties under the direction of a physician.

occupations.title: Registered Nurses
occupations.description: Assess patient health, develop care plans, provide nursing care, and educate patients and families.

occupations.title: Nursing Assistants
occupations.description: Provide or assist with basic care under the direction of licensed nursing staff.

occupations.title: Graphic Designers
occupations.description: Design or create graphics to meet commercial or promotional needs.

occupations.title: Public Relations Specialists
occupations.description: Promote or create an intended public image for individuals, groups, or organizations.

occupations.title: Customer Service Representatives
occupations.description: Interact with customers to provide information, resolve complaints, and handle service requests.

occupations.title: Human Resources Specialists
occupations.description: Recruit, screen, interview, or place individuals within an organization and support HR activities.

occupations.title: Sales Representatives
occupations.description: Sell goods or services to businesses or individuals and develop customer relationships.

occupations.title: Bookkeeping, Accounting, and Auditing Clerks
occupations.description: Compute, classify, and record numerical data to keep financial records complete and accurate.

occupations.title: Logisticians
occupations.description: Analyze and coordinate an organization's supply chain and the movement of products or resources.

occupations.title: Construction Laborers
occupations.description: Perform physical labor at construction sites, operate tools, and support building activities.

occupations.title: Heavy and Tractor-Trailer Truck Drivers
occupations.description: Drive heavy trucks to transport goods over local or long-distance routes.
